meta.notes: DRAFT by Claude (s348) for Ben. JIDDA = the WATER WORLD: a bright turquoise LAGOON ARCHIPELAGO where the water is the road, with PLENTY OF OPEN SEA TO SAIL AND JETSKI (Ben s348). The whole map is sea; ISLANDS (new "islands" field) are the land. TOWN ISLAND (round, the hub) with the crest mooring + transport pad; piers + causeways to: the CASTLE HEADLAND (N, the sea fortress + lighthouse) and the BARRACKS ISLE (rope bridge), FARM ISLAND (S), the SURF beach island (E: contest stands, Marina, volleyball, swim + tube starts) with OCEAN WORLD (NE) and the SPACE DOCK isle (SE). CORSAIR REACH (W) is across the FERRY LANE (a boat ride in the 2D game). A wide ring of OPEN SEA round everything for sailing, the jetski run, the speedboat + the regatta; a lonely sandbar holds the relic. 2D keys (jTown, jFarm…) are kept in "room2d"; 3D keys start with jidda. EVERY BUILDING UNIQUE ("outside" note) + roof sign + eye-level door sign. CORSAIR REACH (Ben s348) = FOUR separate islands (Landing, The Crag, The Shoals, Pirate Hideout) joined by HIGH ARCHED BRIDGES; open channels between them so you can JETSKI / boat between the areas and under the bridges. Every water crossing on the map (causeway, piers, rope bridges, boardwalk) is a high bridge with room for jet skis + boats underneath. VENICE (Ben s348): Town Island is a Venice-style canal town: the GRAND CANAL (water with "canal": true cuts the island) + 2 side rios, fondamenta walks both banks, 3 bridges over the Grand Canal (Crest Bridge in the middle), Piazza della Cresta + campanile on the north bank, gondola + water taxi stop. SPREAD OUT (Ben s348): map.half 540; Farm Island moved 150 m south, the castle headland + barracks isle 80 m north, the surf beach, Ocean World + dock isles 80 m east, so there are wide channels of open sea between Town Island and every other island.

buildings.label: Tavern
buildings.note: Bar + shelf, LONG BOARD shuffleboard (2D), jukebox, darts. UNIQUE TAVERN GAME: CORNHOLE + WASHERS (boards out on the beach deck too). Jody (map piece), Jago, Jamos.
buildings.outside: Venetian osteria on the Fondamenta: pastel ochre plaster, gothic pointed-arch windows, a wooden altana roof terrace, fishing nets + glass floats, a LONG BOARD sign, cornhole boards out on a canal-side deck.

buildings.label: Item Shop
buildings.outside: Narrow pink palazzino shop with a striped awning over the water steps, crates of shells + lobster pots, an anchor sign.

buildings.label: Armory
buildings.outside: Small stone fort-house on the canal with iron-barred arches, crossed harpoons + cutlasses, a cannon on the water steps.

buildings.label: Foxy Blends
buildings.note: Four stools, blender, menu board, NOW HIRING. Julep. + FOX GELATO kiosk outside.
buildings.outside: Coral-pink café with a canal-side terrace under a striped awning, a giant pineapple-cup on the roof, the FOX GELATO cart by the bridge.

buildings.label: Pearl Bank
buildings.outside: White marble palazzo with a row of pointed gothic arches + a pearl in a shell over the door (the grandest after the castle).

buildings.label: Galactic Post Office (Meru Embassy)
buildings.outside: Rose-brick post house with a little clock tower + the Meru flag, bottle-post rack, the Galactic Post dish on the altana.

buildings.label: Jib's Surf Shop
buildings.note: Boards to the ceiling, surfboard rack, counter. Jib. Get the SURFBOARD here.
buildings.outside: Bright yellow boathouse with surfboards racked up the front like a fence, a giant board standing on end at the water steps.

buildings.label: Harbour Infirmary
buildings.outside: Cream palazzo with blue shutters + a cloister courtyard, a lifebuoy + red cross banner, the medevac helipad across Rio East.

buildings.label: Harbour Watch
buildings.outside: Blue-shuttered watch house on the corner of Rio West with a spyglass loggia on the roof + a patrol boat at the steps.

buildings.label: Sea Rescue & Fire
buildings.outside: Red boathouse with a big arched water gate: the red rescue boat slides straight into the Grand Canal.

buildings.label: The Tide Times
buildings.outside: Tall thin palazzo striped in blue + white with a radio mast on the altana, sea-flag ticker on the balcony.

buildings.label: Hook & Harpoon
buildings.note: SPECIAL WEAPONS: the 8 extra ranged + melee
buildings.outside: Dark tarred-timber shop under a portico, a giant harpoon through the sign, racks behind net screens.

buildings.label: Driftwood Cottage

buildings.label: The Sea Chest
buildings.note: The famous Jidda relic to BUY (DRAFT: Ben picks)
buildings.outside: Tiny shop shaped like an open treasure chest at the foot of a bridge, gold coins spilling over the step.

buildings.label: Shell House
buildings.outside: Burano-style house painted bright pink with a white door frame + a washing line over the rio.

buildings.label: Boat House
buildings.outside: Burano-style house painted turquoise with an upturned old boat hull as a porch roof.

buildings.label: Stilt House
buildings.outside: Burano-style house painted lemon yellow, tall + thin, flower boxes on every window.

buildings.label: The Castle
buildings.note: Twelve columns, a very long carpet, no windows; throne. Jest on the throne.
buildings.outside: The grandest building: a DOGE-style sea palace on the headland: pink + white diamond-patterned walls over two storeys of white gothic arcades, turquoise domes on the corner towers, a sea gate with a portcullis, the crest on a balcony over the water.

buildings.label: Barracks

buildings.outside: Barracks isle: a round stone keep with a worn sparring ring on the roof, eight bunk windows, a boat landing.

buildings.label: Lighthouse
buildings.outside: Tall red + white striped lighthouse with a turning lamp at night, a keeper's hut at its foot.

buildings.label: Farm Island

buildings.outside: The only field on Jidda: a thatched farmhouse at the head of the carrot rows, a windmill, the WHACK A MOLE marquee.

buildings.label: Surf Contest Stands
buildings.note: THE BREAK surf minigame (three waves, one heat). Job (champion), Joss, 3 flamingos.
buildings.outside: UNIQUE SPORT: wooden grandstands facing the break, a judges' tower with flags, the HEAT SHEET board, five boards standing in the sand.

buildings.label: Jidda Marina
buildings.note: Car rental Jidda style: JET SKI, SPEEDBOAT, SAILBOAT. WATER TAXI PILOT job (NOT BUILT YET).
buildings.outside: Boat hire on the pier: a blue boathouse with a sail-shaped roof, jet skis + a speedboat + sailboats tied up at the floating dock.

buildings.label: Ocean World
buildings.outside: Big aquarium dome of blue glass with a dolphin show pool out front, a giant leaping-dolphin statue over the gate.

THE DIG SITE on The Shoals (2D reach hoard, 600 gold): an X marked in the sand beside the wreck. Dig with the spade → the FLOOR GIVES WAY: a sand sinkhole opens, the player falls through into THE DROP [jDrop] (dark flooded rock, no way back up). Mark it clearly: a big X of red-painted driftwood + a crack ring in the sand.
THE MOLE HOLE on Farm Island: where you CLIMB OUT of the cave at the end (from THE MOLE SHAFT [jShaft]).

THE BREAK (surf): the surf zone off the east side of the Surf beach island, facing the contest stands. Waves roll in from the open sea (east) onto the beach: 3 lines of breaking waves between x 365 and 430. The SURF CONTEST minigame (3D-GAMES/Jidda Surf.dc.html: three waves, one heat) runs here; free surfing on the Surfboard any time.

look.notes: VENICE ON THE SEA (Ben s348): a bright lagoon city. TOWN ISLAND is VENICE: the GRAND CANAL right through it with gondolas + water taxis, side rios, arched stone bridges (the big covered Crest Bridge like the Rialto), PIAZZA DELLA CRESTA with a tall brick CAMPANILE, pastel palazzi (ochre, rose, cream, terracotta) with white gothic arches, wooden altana roof terraces, striped mooring poles, geraniums in window boxes, lanterns on the fondamenta. The houses are Burano-bright (pink, turquoise, yellow). The castle is a pink + white Doge-style sea palace. The OUTER ISLANDS stay LUSH garden islands (palms, flowering bushes, sandy coves). Clear turquoise lagoon near the islands, deep blue open sea round the edge for sailing + jetski.

terrain.notes: JIDDA = flat islands in the sea. The Crag on Corsair Reach is a rocky rise; the headland is a low cliff under the castle. Everything else flat sand + grass. PALMS on every island beach.
